# GitHub Copilot Explain Instructions

When I ask you to explain code:

- First: one-sentence summary of what it does
- Then: step-by-step flow with bullet points
- Then: why this pattern was chosen
- Then: potential improvements or gotchas
- Use simple words, never assume I’m dumb — just clear
